cohort: The study included 488 adolescent and adult mothers receiving care in public hospitals in North Wollo Zone, northern Ethiopia.
finding: Adolescent mothers exhibited significantly higher rates of adverse maternal outcomes, including preterm labor, antepartum hemorrhage, anemia, pregnancy-induced hypertension, malpresentation, cephalopelvic disproportion, major perineal tears, and cesarean delivery, compared to adult mothers.
mod_finding: Adolescent mothers had a significantly increased likelihood of cesarean delivery compared to adult mothers.
